def dict_diff(dicts):
    """
    Subset dictionaries to keys which map to multiple values
    """
    keys = set(dicts[0].keys())
    for d in dicts[1:]:
        keys = keys.intersection(d.keys())
    return [d.get(key, None) for key in keys]
